Contract AutomatedTellerMachineSystem::inputCard(cardid: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		matchingCards: Set(BankCard) = BankCard.allInstance()->select(o|o.CardID = cardid),
		foundCard: BankCard = BankCard.allInstance()->any(o|o.CardID = cardid),
		cardExists: Boolean = if matchingCards.isEmpty() = false 
		then true 
		else false 
		endif 
	precondition:
		BankCard.allInstance()->isUnique(o: BankCard|o.CardID)
	postcondition:
		cardExists = true and
		self.CardIDValidated = true and
		self.InputCard = foundCard and
		result = true or
		cardExists = false and
		self.CardIDValidated = false and
		self.InputCard = null and
		result = false
}
